props.name: interactive
props.description: The whole card opens something (a link or a button in it covers the card): it hovers with the subtle tier and presses with the medium tier, like a file card. Off for a card that only shows content.

props.name: size
props.description: The card's width, one of the two a card in a message has (cards-in-messages.md): `item` for a card that opens one thing, at most 400px and the message's width on a phone; `content` for a card that shows other messages, at most 560px. Unset, the card sets no width.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
